desc:
⚽ START YOUR SOCCER CAREER!

👍 THUMBS UP (LIKE) the game for FREE CODES!
👥 Join community for FREE CODES!

From an unknown kid to a living legend... every choice is yours!

- 🎮 Build and Manage your football player, then live season after season: training, media, dressing room, transfers, injuries,
football life.
- ⚡ Decisive moments - you take the penalty.
- 🏆 Win trophies, chase The Golden Ball, 
climb the world leaderboard.
- 📈 Overall goes from 0 to ???. Almost nobody gets past 100....
- 🔁 Retire, beat your own records, go again.
- ⚙️ Redeem codes in the Settings menu!

All players in this game are fictional. This game is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by any football organization, league, or professional player.
